commits.subject: go-backend: HTTP/SSE git layer (snapshot, log, refs, status, diff, search) + Wails GitService renderer adapter; GitForge branding sweep
go-backend: Wails 3 shell serving the Vue frontend; GitForge.app bundle on macOS
Release v1.0.2
commits.body:
Faster, more reliable multi-repo navigation: windowed sidebar rows, heavy-switch skeletons, cached repo validation with background preload, the shifted-tab data-leak fix, and mouse-drag tab reordering with live preview. Adds sidebar section/column settings, a curl|sh installer with in-place self-update and CHECKSUMS.txt, and `npm run icons` for regenerating icons from docs/icon.svg.

Expands the native application menu: richer About metadata, Settings (Cmd/Ctrl+,), File (new/close/reopen tab plus clone/init/open repository), View (relaunch, fullscreen, app zoom), Window (minimize, zoom, open tabs), and Help links. Adds the `app_relaunch` command, window/webview permissions, and shares repo tab/clone/init actions between the UI and the menu. Also fixes the installer checksum check to verify only the downloaded asset.

commits.subject: Improve big-repo navigation: windowed sidebar rows, heavy-switch skeleton, perf bridge
commits.body:
- Windowed (virtualized) sidebar sections: SidebarVirtualList + virtualWindow
  render only visible rows; large sections (remote branches, tags) stay smooth
  with thousands of entries
- Tab switching: pendingRepoHeavy raises the loading skeleton immediately for
  heavy cached switches, and the skeleton becomes an overlay so the outgoing
  repository stays mounted during the blocking first paint
- Restore splash: boot into 'restoring' screen instead of flashing the startup
  picker; fall back safely when there is nothing to restore or init fails
- Perf diagnostics: perfRecord/addPerfSink in shared/perf, perfBridge to print
  frontend samples on the terminal during tauri dev, and Rust phase timings
  (open/activate/preload) on stderr via GIT_LIGHT_PERF or debug builds
- Commit box: enforce the 72-char summary limit with a live counter and a
  divider between summary and description
- Search overlay: autofocus input, Escape via window keydown, lighter empty hint

commits.subject: Rework tab reordering to mouse-drag with live preview
commits.body:
Replaces HTML5 drag-and-drop: press-and-drag moves the tab in place with
autoscroll at the row edges, and the final order is committed through
reorderTabs(paths). Threshold keeps clicks working; the close button is
excluded via data-tab-close

commits.subject: Add npm run icons: regenerate icons from docs/icon.svg via app-icon.json
Batch stash base lookups and move app-data file IO off worker threads
commits.body:
fetch_stashes resolves every stash base with a single positional rev-parse
and looks up subjects by sha (log --no-walk dedupes and reorders, so the
old positional cursor was wrong); main.rs reads/writes recents and
favorites via tokio::fs so async commands no longer block a runtime
worker (adds tokio fs feature)

commits.subject: Add sidebar section states and column width editing to settings
commits.body:
Sidebar sections get an expanded/collapsed/hidden tri-state control
(SettingsSegmentedRow), and the Commits category gains exact column width
inputs with clamped ranges and a reset button

commits.subject: Improve tab switching: delayed loading skeleton, immediate tab highlight, drag to reorder
commits.body:
- Cold switches set pendingRepoPath and swap the panes for a skeleton that
  appears after 120ms (useDelayedFlag), so fast switches never flash
- The clicked tab highlights before the snapshot lands and reverts if the
  switch fails while it is still the newest request
- Tabs can be rearranged by drag and drop (repoTabs.moveTab)

commits.subject: Speed up tab switches: cache repo validation, background preload, and gate commands during activation
Simplify website install section and add npm run site preview script
Fix shifted-tab data leak: re-point backend repo on tab switch
Add curl|sh installer, self-update in place, and CHECKSUMS.txt
commits.body:
- scripts/install.sh: macOS one-line installer/updater; downloads the
  release tarball without quarantine, verifies sha256 against
  CHECKSUMS.txt, swaps /Applications/Git Light.app and re-seals ad-hoc
- release.yml: publish CHECKSUMS.txt asset after every release
- app_self_update (Rust): download + verify + extract, then detached
  swap script that restarts the app on the new version
- updater: route macOS Check for Updates through the in-place installer
  (replaces browser download flow that re-triggers Gatekeeper)
- README.md + docs/index.html: recommend the one-line install, add
  Gatekeeper troubleshooting

- Backend: new repos module (clone/init/discover with validation), git_clone_repo/git_init_repo/git_discover_repos commands, executed-command log with truncation, remote fetch/push timeouts
- Frontend: CloneDialog/InitDialog + StartupView onboarding, GitOutputDrawer + gitOutput store, ShortcutRecorder + keybindings store with settings UI, auto-fetch interval preference, graph filter utility

commits.subject: Fix Release: tauri-action@v2 tag does not exist upstream
commits.body: Upstream tauri-apps/tauri-action has no v2 line (newest is v1); @v2 fails to resolve and kills all build jobs at setup. Pin @v1, which supports the same inputs.

commits.subject: Fix snapshot tests under detached HEAD (tag builds)
commits.body: full_snapshot and favorites tests snapshotted the ambient checkout, which has no current branch and no local branches on tag checkouts. Use a hermetic temp repo with main checked out plus a side branch.

commits.subject: Fix Windows rebase editors: PowerShell instead of cmd /C
commits.body: Quoted cmd /C invocations get mangled for TEMP paths under C:\Users\... on Windows runners ('unneradmin'/'UNNER~1' is not recognized), even with forward slashes. Drive GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR/GIT_EDITOR with powershell -File scripts using single-quoted literal paths instead, avoiding cmd.exe parsing entirely. Test now surfaces full stdout/stderr on failure.

commits.subject: Fix Windows CI: CRLF, /tmp path, cmd backslash escapes
commits.body: stash_roundtrip_and_reset_undo: set core.autocrlf=false in test init_repo so checkouts keep LF on Windows. rejects_non_repo: /tmp does not exist on Windows; use a fresh tempdir instead. windows_rebase_bundle: emit forward slashes in generated .cmd paths; native backslash paths contain \r sequences (C:\Users\runneradmin) that shell layers can mangle.

commits.subject: Fix CI: build frontend before cargo test
commits.body: tauri::generate_context!() in src-tauri/src/main.rs requires ../dist at compile time. CI ran cargo test/clippy without ever producing dist/, so all Rust jobs failed. Run npm run build (vite -> dist/) before the Rust steps in CI test, test-windows and Release verify.
